item.title: PARA-PV: Physics-Aware Retrieval-Augmented PV Prediction Based on Frozen Foundation Model and Distribution Shift Correction
item.description:

👤 Hang Fan, Weican Liu, Ying Lu, Dunnan Liu, Long Cheng, Wei Wei
arXiv:2607.08079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for reliable grid dispatch and renewable energy integration, yet it remains challenging because PV generation is jointly shaped by weather variability, day-night transitions, regime-dependent dynamics, and strict physical constraints. item.title: Chip-integrated metasurface-enabled single-photon skyrmion sources
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Xujing Liu, Yinhui Kan, Shailesh Kumar, Liudmilla F. Kulikova, Valery A. Davydov, Viatcheslav N. Agafonov 等7位作者
Nature Communications, Published online: 11 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75516-5 On-chip generation of single-photon skyrmions is challenging due to the nanoscale confinement of quantum emitters. Here the authors demonstrate a metasurface-integrated quantum emitter platform enabling room-temperature on-chip generation of single-photon skyrmions without requiring magnetic fields.

item.title: Accelerating Two-Dimensional Computational Fluid Dynamics via Hybrid Spectral-Geometric Neural Architectures
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Carlos Andrés Angulo Rosales
Computationally resolving fluid dynamics around complex, irregular boundaries remains a central challenge in computational physics due to the multi-scale nature of complex fluid interactions. Fully resolving these dynamics through traditional projection solvers is computationally prohibitive for real-time applications, motivating data-driven machine learning alternatives. In this work, we propose a novel hybrid neural architecture for large-scale fluid simulation that combines the localized feature extraction capabilities of convolutional networks with the global wave-resolution efficiency of spectral methods. item.description:

👤 Sirui Lu, Erickson Tjoa, J. Ignacio Cirac
arXiv:2607.07857v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We build a team of specialized large language-model agents and present an agent-driven workflow for research-level formalization in theoretical physics, with the autoformalization of the fundamental theorem of matrix-product states as a demonstration. The agents, coordinated through a structured mathematical blueprint and periodic human review, orchestrated and executed the full formalization autonomously. For some statements, the agents were able to explore new proof routes that are not part of the standard literature. item.title: 从表面-吸附物模型提取量子哈密顿量的可复现工作流
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Manisha Malhotra, Fabio Rinaldi, Neil Ramarapu
该工作提出一个开源、可复现流程，用于将DFT优化的表面催化模型转换为量子算法所需的费米子或量子比特哈密顿量。流程包括从 slab 模型中截取氢封端活性位簇、自动选择前线活性空间，并在Hartree–Fock阶段用有效芯势处理重元素内核。作者以金红石IrO2(110)上H*/OH*吸附为例，从(8e,7o)活性空间生成14量子比特哈密顿量，并通过HF能量重构和精确对角化验证了端到端一致性与物理合理性。

item.title: Idiobionics：隐私与智能机器人假肢的统一框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kwesi Afari Darfoor, Patrick M. Pilarski, Bailey Kacsmar
该文关注下一代仿生肢体中生物系统与数字系统的持续紧耦合，以及由传感器和人工智能控制带来的半自主、可共适应特性。作者指出，这些能力提升同时引入可被恶意利用的隐私威胁，可能影响用户采纳与安全使用。文章提出“idiobionics”这一新研究方向，旨在系统理解并缓解智能机器人假肢中的隐私风险。

item.title: 基于 sEMG 信号的实时手势识别图神经网络模型
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pragatheeswaran Vipulanandan, Kamal Premaratne, Manohar Murthi
该文提出一种面向手部假肢和增强现实控制的表面肌电信号表示方法，将前臂肌肉激活模式编码为图结构，并用图神经网络进行实时手势识别。实验使用 MyoBand 的 8 通道前臂 sEMG 数据，覆盖 8 名健康受试者。结果显示平均分类准确率达到 99%，图构建与预测平均耗时 48 ms，具备实时应用潜力。

item.title: Gapless fracton quantum spin liquid and emergent photons in a 2D spin-1 model
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Nils Niggemann, Meghadeepa Adhikary, Yannik Schaden-Thillmann, Johannes Reuther
Nature Communications, Published online: 11 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74797-0 Gapless fracton quantum spin liquids described by higher rank gauge theories have remained elusive in microscopic quantum spin models. Here, the authors demonstrate a spin 1 square lattice model exhibiting signatures of a rank 2 U(1) fracton quantum spin liquid, including suppressed pinch points and emergent photon like excitations revealed by Green function Monte Carlo simulations.

item.description:

Nature Communications, Published online: 11 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75429-3 Efficient 1.55 micrometer light sources are needed for telecom and infrared photonics, but realizing them with perovskite quantum dots is challenging due to bandgap limitations. Li et al. used Er3 + -doping and hydrogen-bonded ordered assembly in CsPbCl3 to enable efficient electroluminescence.

item.title: Evolution of Nanotechnology Using Quantum Dot Cellular Automata
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Priyanka Wani, Sankit Kassa
The use of Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) has come to light as a promising nanoelectronic technology that can surpass the scaling restrictions, high power consumption and area of the Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) circuits. In this chapter, compact QCA-based combinational and sequential circuits are designed and analyzed for performance, with a particular focus on an optimized D-latch and memory architecture based on SRAM. QCA Designer 2.0.3 is used to implement and analyse fundamental QCA logic gates, multiplexers and memory structures. The single-layer QCA D-latch is realized with just 14 cells, the cell layout area 0.007 µm² and the clock latency 0.5 cycles. item.title: New test certifies quantum measurements that simpler methods cannot mimic
item.description:
📚 Physics News
Proving that one quantum measurement is more powerful than another has long been difficult. Physicists from Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf, Lund University and the University of Innsbruck have now developed and demonstrated a simple technique to certify that a certain class of measurements has properties that cannot be mimicked by simpler means. Their paper is published in the journal PRX Quantum.

item.title: 赋能回答集编程：结合 ASP 与能量模型的端到端神经符号推理与学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jakob Suchan, Julius Monsen, Salim Baloch, Mehul Bhatt
该文提出一种将回答集编程与能量基模型模块化结合的神经符号推理与学习方法。其核心是在连续潜空间中进行联合优化，同时通过 ASP 显式纳入背景知识、约束和非单调推理等声明式语义。作者给出实际实现，并在 MNIST、CLEVR 视觉问答和 MOT 多目标跟踪基准上展示与评估该框架。
